title: Bigfoot Sighting? East Texas Deer Hunters Report Eerie Encounter
excerpt: A father, who was deer hunting with his teenage son, has submitted a report about a nighttime encounter with someone or something that was breaking through branches and throwing rocks.
content:
I was today-years-old when I learned of the existence of the Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization (BFRO). It was founded in 1995 and bills itself as the "only scientific research organization exploring the bigfoot/sasquatch mystery." This online site allows anyone to submit sightings. You can also view recent reports and hear the moaning howl sounds of possible Bigfoot interactions. One of the most recent sighting reports came from Deep East Texas.

November 2026 Possible Bigfoot Engagement

According to a submitted report, a man and his 14-year-old son were deer hunting in the Davy Crockett National Forest in Houston County. Just after dusk, the two were processing a shot deer in the woods near a creek. The man reported that something across the creek threw a branch at them. That branch landed in the water near them. On a couple of occasions, as the man and his son were hiking to their vehicle, rocks were thrown at them. The man yelled at whatever was throwing the rocks, but heard no response. As they continued towards their vehicle, something large was following them, breaking branches along the way. Whatever it was, stopped pursuing them as they neared their truck. According to the report, they were located 28 miles away from the nearest highway.

Another Davy Crockett National Forest Encounter?

Someone responded to this report with an unexplained encounter that occurred in the same forest in 2009. This sighting took place at night and involved a "man covered in fur" crossing the road. The creature looked at the eyewitness and continued walking into the woods. That encounter happened north of Ratliff.

How Many Bigfoot Sightings Have There Been?

According to the BFRO, they have catalogued 75,000 reports over the past several decades. They classify between 5%-10% of those as credible, eyewitness-based sightings.

The Texas Bigfoot Hunt: Notable Sightings and Stories in the Lone Star State

We continue to be fascinated by the mystery of Bigfoot, where reported sightings continue to captivate. Several of these sightings are in East Texas.
